evidence.name: Screen field: Loop the video
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Loop the video" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Loop the video
sections.description: For video media only: turn on to loop the clip continuously, or leave off to play it once and stop. Looping suits short, ambient hero or background videos that keep the screen feeling alive, while play-once suits a clip with a clear start and finish. It has no effect on still images.
